info.description: REST API for Brothers App following Clean Architecture.
info.title: Brothers App API

post.description: Authenticates an active user using a username or email address and password.
post.summary: Sign in with username or email

post.description: Sends an OTP for registration or password reset. Password reset accepts either email or username and returns the recipient email when delivery is started.

parameters.description: OTP purpose and email or username
parameters.name: request

post.description: Replaces the password using a reset-only token and revokes the active session.
Exchanges an email-delivered reset OTP for a single-use reset token.
Rotates the opaque refresh token and returns a new token pair.
Verifies the registration OTP, creates the user, and issues a token pair. Request an OTP first through POST /auth/otp/send.

delete.description: Owner-only operation. Requires an explicit confirmation and preserves financial and audit history.

get.description: This resource is read-only. The optional query parameter filters by phone.

parameters.description: Invitation payload; provide user_id or email
parameters.name: request

get.summary: List active and pending group members

parameters.description: Search by name, username, email, or location
parameters.name: query

get.description: Owner, managers and investors can open any member; an employee only themselves. balance_usd and profit_uzs are returned for employees only.

delete.description: Any manager removes an employee; only the owner removes a manager or investor. Requires a $0 balance and no active orders. The member's old orders can no longer be cancelled.
delete.summary: Remove a member from the group

patch.description: Role: owner only; leaving the employee role needs a $0 balance and no active orders. Location: any manager, employees only; an empty location_id unassigns it.
patch.summary: Change a member's role or location

get.description: Manual adjustments only, newest first, with the member and their current balance.

post.description: Any manager. Records the old and new balance permanently; a wrong adjustment is corrected with another one.

get.description: Newest first. Employees only see orders they take part in.

post.description: Managers create orders for any two employees; an employee only for an order they take part in.
post.summary: Create an order between two employees

get.description: The other party's confirmed amount is hidden until you confirm; their fee is never shown to a party.

patch.description: Any change clears both confirmations. Completed orders cannot be edited.

post.description: A pending order nobody has confirmed is cancelled immediately; the giver, the receiver or the order's creator may do it. Otherwise only the giver or receiver may ask, the requester counts as approved and the other party must approve.
post.summary: Cancel an order or request its cancellation

post.description: approve: only the other party; cancels the order and reverses a completed order's balances and profits. reject: either party ("Keep Order", or the requester withdrawing).
post.summary: Approve or reject a cancellation request

post.description: Only the giver or receiver. When both amounts match the order completes and balances and profits update.
post.summary: Confirm or correct your amount for an order

parameters.description: Amount you received or paid, and the fee you collected
parameters.name: request

get.description: Returns safe profile fields for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates only provided names, avatar URL, and language fields.

get.description: Searches active users by username or email and returns only invitation-safe fields.
get.summary: Find registered users for an invitation

email.description:
Email is required for registration. For password_reset, provide exactly
one of Email or Username.

reason.description:
Reason is a technical explanation for developers, always in English.
Outside development, server errors report only their slug here.
reason.example: invalid data: The amount must be between $1 and $1000000000

BearerAuth.description: Paste the access token only. Standard clients may send "Bearer <token>"; Swagger UI sends the token value directly.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
